summary:
SettingsHandler (lib/src/handlers/settings_handler.dart, 3347 lines, GetIt singleton, imported by 205 files) is the app-wide settings store. About 150 declared settings live as plain fields or Rx fields. A `map` getter acts as the schema (type, default, step and limits, options). Parallel 150-case switches `getByString`/`setByString` sit beside it, and `validateValue` handles the 15 SettingsEnum enums through SettingsEnumRegistry, which main() fills via initSettingsEnumRegistry(). `toJson`/`loadFromJSON` read and write settings.json in the config dir. Maps that are not declared settings are written next to the declared keys: modularUi, modelTasks, modelThreads, modelRunOn, earlierDownloadFolders and hiddenTagsPerBooru.

The same class also owns:
- the booru config list (boorus/<name>.json, the virtual Favourites/Downloads/ForYou/ForYouDoujin/Boards/Collections/History boorus, sorting, prefBooru)
- the global and per-booru hidden tags and marked tags, the cache of e621-style blacklist lines, and per-item tag badges (domain-aware: doujin items are routed to SourceSettingsHandler/DoujinDataHandler)
- the GitHub update check, including a Scaffold changelog page built inside the handler
- the DBHandler instance and Alice
- startup: initialize() runs before runApp (storage permission, load settings, locale, Alice, SAF cache); postInit() runs from MainApp.initHandlers (proxy, video backend registration, DB connect and index, boorus, the external tags/tabs/migration action, update check, DownloadsCheck.offerAfterRestore, SourceLinks.applySaved, OnnxAvailability, ModelTimings).

loadFromJSON does several things on every load:
- forces appMode to Mobile
- sets keys missing from the file to their defaults (startup only)
- runs a one-time Flow-skin migration guarded by flowSkinApplied, then saves at once.

saveSettings(restate:true) also refilters fetched items and calls rootRestate after 1 s; this happens on Settings-hub exit, Debug exit and first launch.

Most settings sub-pages copy values into local state in initState and write them back plus saveSettings in PopScope.onPopInvokedWithResult, so changes apply when the page closes. Recommendations, Modular UI, Links, Models/ModelPage, Debug captures, Theme (500 ms debounced) and the database/cache actions write immediately.

SourceSettingsHandler (singleton, sourceSettings.json, lazy synchronous load) keeps doujin settings in two layers: a global layer under '_global' and per-host overrides. Effective value = override ?? global ?? hardcoded default. It also holds booru source settings (alwaysAdd, defaultFilters):
- BooruHandler.search applies them through composeQuery.
- The search window applies them through withDefaults.
- The doujin blacklist (extend/override) feeds isItemHiddenForDoujin.
- It also stores hiddenPins.

Modular UI has 13 toggles in data/modular_ui.dart. Their values live in SettingsHandler.modularUi, are read with ModularUi.isOn where 10 widget files build, and are edited on ModularUiPage.

The UI is the settings_page hub (7 sections; settings_layout_test checks their order by reading the source file) plus about 30 pages in pages/settings. The main layering problems: models import the handler (modular_ui and 4 enums); the handler imports pages and widgets; UI files host logic (booru test and autodetect, cache-stat isolates, the Sankaku URL updater, model seams in ModelsPage and RecommendationsPage).

features.name: Settings hub with sections
features.what: Sections SOURCES (Boorus & Search, Accounts, Filters, Links, Doujin), RECOMMENDATIONS & AI (Recommendations, Models), LOOK & FEEL (Interface, Modular UI, Theme, Language), VIEWING (Viewer, Video, Performance), DOWNLOADS & STORAGE (Save & cache, Database, Backup & restore), SYSTEM (Network, Privacy, Sync, Logs, Debug), ABOUT (About, Check for updates, Help, Discord, Version, mascot). Leaving the hub saves settings with restate (refilter + root rebuild after 1 s).

features.name: Sync entry gated by database
features.what: Opens LoliSyncPage only when the database is enabled; otherwise shows an error snackbar (sync needs DB).

features.name: Export logs / open logger
features.what: Shown only when Logger.viewController exists. Tap: warning dialog, then exports the newest-first log, redacted, capped at 10 MB. Long-press opens the Talker logger view.

features.name: Debug mode via version row
features.what: 6 taps enable debug mode (persisted since r80); long-press disables it. A snackbar shows each change. Debug mode reveals the Debug entry, the force-save long-press in the booru editor and the debug index buttons.

features.name: Version label
features.what: Shows '<buildCodename>-<versionName>' plus '/ Play' or '/ Test' or '/ Debug'.

features.name: Check for updates / What's new
features.navPath: Settings -> Check for updates; automatic at postInit
features.what: Fetches NO-ob update.json (or update_store.json) from GitHub and shows an update page (Later / Visit releases or Play Store), a 'latest version' snackbar with a 'view latest changelog' action, or a What's-new page once after an update (viewed build kept in secure storage; new users without boorus are skipped). The discord URL is overridden from the update file.

features.name: Help link
features.what: Opens Constants.wikiURL in an external browser.

features.name: Default tags for new tabs
features.what: Tag search box with booru selector, multiple tags, clearable; saved on exit.

features.name: Items per page
features.navPath: Settings -> Boorus & Search -> Items per page
features.what: Number field 10-100 with +/- step 10, reset and validator; clamped on exit.

features.name: Import booru from clipboard
features.what: Reads a loli.snatcher link from the clipboard, renames it '(duplicate)' when the name exists, and opens the editor. Snackbars for an invalid URL or an empty clipboard.

features.name: Preferred booru selector
features.navPath: Settings -> Boorus & Search -> Added boorus dropdown (+help)
features.what: Picking a booru sets it as preferred (sorted first). On leaving the page a dialog asks whether to change the default booru or keep the current one.

features.name: Edit / share / webview / delete booru
features.navPath: Settings -> Boorus & Search -> (selected booru) Edit / Share / Open webview / Delete
features.what: Share asks whether to include credentials, then uses the Android share intent (desktop: clipboard); a help dialog links to Android 'open by default'. Delete is refused while tabs use the booru, otherwise confirmed. Webview opens the booru URL.

features.name: Booru editor form
features.navPath: Settings -> Boorus & Search -> Add new booru / Edit booru
features.what: Name and URL fields (clearable, pasteable, honour the incognito keyboard), Open webview, a 'Source settings' button for existing boorus, a searchable type dropdown, a favicon URL field with live preview, and default tags with tag search for the typed booru.

features.name: Per-type defaults prefill
features.what: Choosing FurAffinity, RedGifs, Rule34.dev, Hanime1, Kusowanka, Rule34Video, nhentai, niyaniya, HDoujin, E-Hentai, HentaiPaw, Kemono, Pawchive, ASMHentai, EAHentai, hentalk, hitomi, Tik.Porn, xxxtik, xxxfollow or Civitai fills an empty URL, name and favicon.

features.name: Per-type instructions
features.what: HTML help for each type: gelbooru.com and rule34.xxx credential warnings, FA, RedGifs, Rule34.dev, Kemono, Pawchive, HDoujin, E-Hentai, nhentai, Hanime1, Kusowanka, Rule34Video, TikPorn, xxxtik, xxxfollow, Civitai, WebView; default text otherwise.

features.name: Credential fields by capability
features.navPath: Booru editor -> User ID / API key fields
features.what: Shown only when the handler reads them; labels per type (Login, Password, Email); API key obscurable; a note when the source has no account. RedGifs has no fields.

features.name: Ignore global blacklist per booru
features.navPath: Booru editor -> Ignore global blacklist for this booru
features.what: Booru (non-doujin) sources only: the global hidden list stops filtering this booru; per-booru lines still apply.

features.name: Per-booru hidden tag lines
features.navPath: Booru editor -> Hidden tag lines for this booru (+ add, delete, syntax help); also Quick access -> '<booru> blacklist'
features.what: Adds or removes e621-style lines that hide posts on this booru only; a help dialog explains the syntax.

features.name: Hydrus access key
features.navPath: Booru editor (type Hydrus) -> Get Hydrus API key
features.what: Requests an access key from the Hydrus client, fills the key field, and shows instructions.

features.name: RedGifs sign-in
features.navPath: Booru editor (type RedGifs) -> Sign in with browser / Sign in again / Sign out; Settings -> Accounts -> RedGifs
features.what: Opens the RedGifs WebView login, a JS hook captures the user bearer JWT (guest tokens rejected), and the token is stored in the API key field. Expiry is decoded to show the signed-in state.

features.name: FurAffinity login and content filter
features.navPath: Booru editor (FurAffinity) -> Log in with browser / Content filter / Log out; Settings -> Accounts -> FurAffinity; FA source settings -> ACCOUNT
features.what: WebView login polls the cookie jar every 1.5 s for a/b and stores them in FurAffinitySessionHandler. Content filter opens /controls/settings/ with the session seeded and syncs it afterwards. Log out.

features.name: Save booru with test
features.navPath: Booru editor -> Save booru (long-press in debug mode = force save)
features.what: Sanitizes the name and tests the source: the special engines skip the scrape test, Hydrus verifies API access, Autodetect tries every detectable type, others run a test search. Failures show the error with a Copy button. Duplicate checks (same config, name, URL), confirm dialog with favicon and type, the old config is replaced, open tabs are re-pointed (applyBooruEdit), a first tab is created when none exist, and the app restates globally.

features.name: Site-URL to API-URL and favicon heuristics
features.what: Sankaku and Idol site URLs become their API hosts; favicon guesses for agn.ph, rule34.us and Sankaku; https:// is added and a trailing slash stripped.

features.name: Accounts overview
features.what: e-hentai/ExHentai, FurAffinity and RedGifs rows with signed-in state. They open the e-hentai login, the FA login, or the first RedGifs source's editor (a snackbar when there is no RedGifs source).

features.name: e-hentai forum login
features.navPath: Settings -> Accounts -> e-hentai; e-hentai source settings -> ACCOUNT -> Log in
features.what: WebView forum login copies ipb_member_id/ipb_pass_hash into EHentaiSessionHandler, fetches igneous from exhentai, then scrubs the shared jar. Reload button.

features.name: Item filters: hidden and marked tags
features.navPath: Settings -> Filters (also from the waterfall error buttons and Quick access)
features.what: Hidden and Marked tabs with search, add, edit and delete dialogs and a duplicate warning; blacklist syntax help. On exit the lists are cleaned and saved and every open tab is refiltered.

features.name: Item filter switches
features.what: Completely hide hidden items, hide marked, hide favourited, hide snatched, hide AI-generated.

features.name: Open source links in the app
features.what: Toggle that enables the Android link-handling component (SourceLinks.apply; re-applied at startup), a button to Android 'Open by default', and the lists of covered and uncovered sources.

features.name: Doujin settings hub
features.what: 'Global doujin settings' plus one entry per configured doujin source (sources with a reader); a hint when there are none.

features.name: Doujin source settings: reading
features.navPath: Settings -> Doujin -> Global or <source>; drawer -> '<doujin source> settings'; booru editor -> Source settings
features.what: Reading direction (ltr/rtl/vertical), page-turn animation, tap zones, double-tap zoom, preload pages (0-20), keep screen on, reader image quality (sources with several sizes). Per-source rows show 'Overridden for this source · tap to reset'.

features.name: Doujin source settings: search
features.what: Default sort (source sort metatag, or nhentai sorts on the global layer), content types (rule34video, per source), only-show language, title language, tag blacklist text, blacklist mode extend/override (per source), import blacklist from account (nhentai API / e-hentai My Tags; merges).

features.name: Doujin source settings: detail, tabs, recommendations, grid
features.navPath: Doujin source settings -> DETAIL PAGE / TABS / RECOMMENDATIONS / GRID
features.what: Detail layout compact/cover; detail cover from first page (e-hentai/eahentai); new-tab placement; tag chip tap menu/newtab; endless recommendations and items per gallery (5-100); feed cards grid/list; cover display fit/crop/adapt; list card height (120-320); list cover width (72-240); tags on grid cards; feed columns portrait (1-5) and landscape (1-8); page preview columns (1-6).

features.name: e-hentai account rows
features.what: Login state (member id, exhentai access or a 'mystery' explanation), Check again (fetchIgneous), Log out, Log in, Site choice e-hentai/exhentai, and buttons for the site's settings, My Tags and Watched pages in a webview with cookies seeded for that visit and scrubbed after.

features.name: eahentai API login
features.navPath: eahentai source settings -> ACCOUNT -> Log in / Log out
features.what: Uses the credentials from the edit page (re-read from the live booru list), checks canSignIn, signs in and keeps the token; snackbars with the site message.

features.name: Booru source settings
features.navPath: Left drawer -> '<source> settings' (Modular UI) / Booru editor -> Source settings
features.what: ACCOUNT row (FA login state, or credentials leading to the edit page); 'Always add to searches' terms; Default filters (a DoujinFiltersBlock over the site's sort/order/rating metatags); hidden-tag count with a link to Filters; About this site (engine, host, BooruSiteNotes).

features.name: Source query composition
features.navPath: automatic (every booru search; search window Filters card)
features.what: composeQuery appends the stored default of every filter group the query leaves unset (only values the site offers), then always-add terms not already present; doujin sources are untouched. withDefaults shows the saved defaults as checked chips.

features.name: Doujin blacklist and hidden pins store
features.navPath: automatic (tag menu 'add to hidden', drawer doujin blacklist rows, pins hide)
features.what: addBlacklistTag on the global or source layer (also a strong 'no' signal for the recommender); removeBlacklistTag from both layers; isItemHiddenForDoujin is the only hidden check for doujin items; dropHiddenPins; reloadFromDisk after a restore.

features.name: AI recommendations / AI learning switches
features.what: Two independent toggles: the learned model orders the recommendation surfaces; the model keeps learning. A warning when the DB is off.

features.name: Recommender report cards
features.navPath: Settings -> Recommendations -> Booru model / Doujin model
features.what: Interactions and learning steps, last update, taste-centroid count, Likes and Dislikes chips (tap: more of this / less of this / forget it), a For You button, and 'forget everything learned' with confirmation.

features.name: SauceNAO key for boards
features.what: API key field saved with a 600 ms debounce (flushed on dispose).

features.name: Models overview
features.what: All models off; a card per model (downloaded, runs on, jobs on); Picture decoding (phone / straight to size / Dart) with an explain button and timings; Saved vectors space chips with usage (prune and compact on change).

features.name: Model download sections
features.what: Text encoder, looks model and image tagger: preset chips or a custom Hugging Face repo, Download / Download again / Cancel / Delete, status line, and a 'Use the <model>' toggle.

features.name: Tagger Try it
features.navPath: Settings -> Models -> Image tagger -> Try it on a picture
features.what: Picks a picture through the system photo picker (PickerWatch: failed / lost / late), tags it, shows tags, rating and timings. A picture lost when Android ended the app is recovered. Hidden when the tryIt job is off.

features.name: Model jobs
features.what: Per-job toggles (text: learning, forYou, boards; look: learning, forYou, similar, boards; tagger: tryIt, boards). Looks extras: read frames from playing videos, frames on For You and in other tabs (playing / reaction / off), remember looks. Tagger: tag reactions.

features.name: Model Run on / NPU
features.what: Segmented CPU/XNNPACK/NNAPI/NPU limited to what the build offers, with an explain button (timings, available providers). Prompts to download the looks model's full-precision half for NPU. NPU copy line, Compile again (+explain), refused and failed notes.

features.name: Model thread counts
features.navPath: Settings -> Models -> <model> -> Threads while you wait / in the background
features.what: +/- 1..cores with an explain button (what it does, cost, recommendation, measured timings); the model session reopens.

features.name: Interface: hand side and search bar
features.what: Hand side (+help), show search bar in preview grid, move input to top in search view, tab pill (experimental), search-view quick actions panel, search input autofocus.

features.name: Interface: system behaviour
features.what: Predictive back (changing it restates the theme), disable vibration, hide status bar (applied immediately), personalized recommendations (interest tracking), inline related-posts grids, bottom info sheet plus its size (0.5-3 thirds), new-tab placement for a single tap (end/next).

features.name: Interface: grid
features.what: Preview columns portrait and landscape (warnings above 4/8), preview quality (+help), preview display square/rectangle/staggered plus a fallback for staggered, don't scale images (warning dialog), GIF thumbnails (requires don't-scale), scroll-previews buttons position, mouse wheel modifier (desktop only).

features.name: Modular UI switches
features.what: 13 switches grouped by area. Search window: History, Pinned tags, Popular tags (off by default), Site filters. Left sidebar: Source settings button, Pinned tags button. Preview grid: Feed scrollbar, Seen thumbnails at once. Viewer: Linked media button, Videos at screen size, Pictures at most 4K, Post actions as buttons. Whole app: Draw under hidden status bar (off). Only non-default values are stored; parts that are off are not built.

features.name: Theme mode, AMOLED, dynamic colour
features.what: System/light/dark with icons; black background (dark/system); dynamic colour (Android 12+). Applied after a 500 ms debounce.

features.name: Theme presets and custom colours
features.navPath: Settings -> Theme -> Theme / Primary colour / Secondary colour / Reset
features.what: Presets Flow, Pink, Purple, Blue, Teal, Red, Green, Halloween, Custom shown with swatches; Custom has colour-picker dialogs (wheel, custom, b/w) and a reset.

features.name: Font family
features.what: Bottom sheet with default fonts, 'view more fonts', and a custom Google Font dialog with preview (English plus the current locale); reset to System.

features.name: Drawer mascot
features.navPath: Settings -> Theme -> Enable drawer mascot / Set custom mascot / Remove custom mascot
features.what: Toggle; a SAF image is picked and copied by ImageWriter on exit; remove deletes the file.

features.name: Flow skin one-time migration
features.what: Older installs get the Flow preset, dark mode, no AMOLED and no dynamic colour once (flowSkinApplied), saved at once.

features.name: Language
features.what: Dropdown System / en / ru / tr / ja with flags; changing it reloads the boorus (localized virtual names), saves and backs up tabs. 'Help us translate' link and a POEditor progress card (network).

features.name: Viewer: preload and quality
features.what: Preload amount (0-4), preload size limit (GB), preload height limit, image quality sample/full, scroll direction, toolbar position, zoom button position, change-page buttons position.

features.name: Viewer: behaviour toggles
features.what: Hide toolbar on open, expand details by default, hide translation notes, dim already-viewed posts, fast GIF playback, rotation, prevent sleep, open/close animation (hero), custom page-change animation, Kanna loading GIF.

features.name: Clear viewed / viewing history
features.navPath: Settings -> Viewer -> Clear viewed history (when dimming) / Clear viewing history
features.what: Confirm dialogs; clears SeenPost (SearchHandler.clearSeenPosts) or ViewedPost (History feed).

features.name: Viewer toolbar buttons order
features.what: Reorderable list (long-press or handle) with an enable checkbox per button (info cannot be disabled), icons, reset and help. Buttons: snatch, favourite, info, share, linked media, select, open, slideshow, reload no scale, toggle quality, external player, image search, not interested.

features.name: Default share action
features.what: Ask, post URL (with tags), file URL (with tags), file (with tags), Hydrus (only when a Hydrus booru exists).

features.name: Volume buttons scrolling and slideshow
features.what: Use volume buttons for scrolling (+help; applied with ServiceHandler.setVolumeButtons), scroll speed, slideshow duration, slideshow duration for videos/GIFs.

features.name: Video settings
features.what: Disable videos (+help), autoplay, keep paused after a manual pause, start muted. Experimental: media_kit engine plus pool size (1-20) and start delay (0-5000 ms); better_player engine plus cache MB and per-file MB; backend normal/mpv/mdk; mpv hardware acceleration, VO, HWDEC; video cache mode (+help). The backend is re-registered on exit.

features.name: Performance page and low performance mode
features.what: Low performance mode (confirm dialog; sets thumbnail previews, sample quality, 2/4 columns, preload 0, size 0.2, height 8192, autoplay off, scaling on). Also preview quality, image quality, columns, preload amount/size/height, don't scale images, autoplay, preload videos, disable videos.

features.name: Save & cache: downloads
features.what: Snatch quality, snatch cooldown, download notifications, snatch on favourite, favourite on snatch, write image data JSON on save (needs a custom folder on Android).

features.name: Download folders
features.what: Set storage directory (SAF; a cancel keeps the folder), reset, earlier download folders (list, remove, add), check downloads against disk (DownloadsCheck).

features.name: Cache settings and stats
features.what: Cache previews, cache media, video cache mode, delete cache after (Never .. 1 month), cache size limit, stats per type (total, favicons, thumbnails, samples, media, WebView; computed in isolates) with clear per type, clear all cache.

features.name: Database settings and maintenance
features.what: Enable database (+help), indexing (creates or drops indexes; debug create/drop buttons), search history, tag type fetching, delete database, clear snatched, clear favourites, clear search history (each confirmed). Leaving is blocked while working.

features.name: Sankaku favourites URL update
features.what: Pick the Sankaku/Idol type and an optional query; reloads each saved item (100 ms pace) and updates its URLs. Progress counts, skip current, stop, purge failed, retry failed.

features.name: Backup & restore checklist and folder
features.what: Checklist of items (All/None). Folder: select (SAF, validated), back up, restore (choose items present), reset. Non-Android shows an Android-only message. Leaving is blocked while busy.

features.name: Google Drive backups
features.what: Set or change the OAuth client (secure storage), link the account (dialog on failure), back up into a named snapshot, restore from the snapshot picker (dates, delete), unlink. The database comes back whole or in parts, a confirm dialog follows, and the app restarts after 3 s when needed.

features.name: Network: certificates and proxy
features.what: Allow self-signed certificates; proxy direct/system/http/socks5/socks4 with address, username and password; applied by initProxy on exit and at startup.

features.name: Custom user agent
features.navPath: Settings -> Network -> Custom user agent (+help) / Set browser user agent
features.what: Free text (empty = default), a button sets the default browser UA.

features.name: Cookie cleaner
features.what: Pick a booru to list its WebView cookies (plus Windows globals), delete one, clear the booru's cookies, or clear all.

features.name: Privacy: app alias, lock, blur, incognito keyboard
features.what: Launcher display name alias (7 aliases; restart dialog; reverted on failure), app lock with an auto-lock timeout (local auth), blur on leave, incognito keyboard (Android).

features.name: Debug overlays and tools
features.what: Performance graph, FPS graph, image stats, video stats (memory only), blur images and mute (dev builds), desktop list drag, animation speed cycle, tags manager, text parser test, resolution and pixel ratio, logger, webview test, delete all cookies, clear secure storage (dev), get and set session string (tabs JSON).

features.name: Trace recorder
features.navPath: Settings -> Debug -> Record a trace / Stop recording
features.what: PerfTrace start and stop; the report goes into the log in parts and into a captures file; a dialog shows up to 20,000 characters with Copy (handles the Binder failure).

features.name: Captures folder
features.navPath: Settings -> Debug -> Captures folder / Use the download folder for captures
features.what: SAF folder for trace and source-capture files; reset to '<download folder>/captures'.

features.name: Source capture
features.what: Enter a site and 'open and record' in a webview (pages, resources, a JS network hook, popups blocked); fetch response bodies; summary; save to the captures folder (also automatic when the browser closes); share; copy (shortened when too big); discard; contents list; an interrupted session is recovered.

features.name: Text parser test
features.what: Custom input rendered with ParsedText plus a segments debug view; about 40 samples in 10 categories with a debug dialog and tap feedback.

features.name: Settings persistence and validation
features.what: settings.json is loaded before the first frame. Each value is validated by schema type and range (out-of-range ints are reset to their default on save); legacy enum string encodings and the legacy hatedTags/lovedTags keys are accepted; missing keys get defaults; appMode is forced to Mobile; isDebug is persisted.

features.name: Device-specific settings excluded from LoliSync
features.what: deviceSpecificSettings (about 60 keys: theme, proxy, paths, DB, video backend, model threads and run-on, captures path, earlier folders, ...) are stripped from the sync payload.

features.name: Booru list management
features.what: Loads boorus/*.json (deletes types that cannot be saved; flags Hydrus); adds the virtual Favourites, Downloads, For You, For You (doujin), Boards, Collections and History boorus when the DB is on; sorts alphabetically with the preferred booru first and the virtual boorus last; ensureXBooru creates them lazily.

features.name: Blacklist evaluation and tag badges
features.what: Global and per-booru e621-style lines with cache; isItemHiddenForBooru honours ignoreGlobalBlacklist; parseTagsListForItem gives hidden, marked, sound and AI badges (capped at 5); doujin items use the doujin blacklist and starred tags.

features.name: Startup post-init chain
features.what: Proxy, video backend registration (normal=media_kit native, mpv=media_kit, mdk=fvp; desktop fvp), DB connect with status, index create or drop, boorus, then the external action (tags, tabs, doujin migration, bookmarks merge); then update check, downloads check after a restore, source links, ONNX providers, model timings.

features.name: Settings enums with localized names
features.what: 15 SettingsEnum enums with backwards-compatible JSON strings and locName for option lists; GalleryButton with disableable and locName.

features.name: Misc persisted UI state
features.what: previewWindowRect (floating tag preview window position), lastSyncIp and lastSyncPort (LoliSync page), kemonoSidebar, furAffinitySidebar and kemonoPostFullImages (flipped from drawers).

layerViolations.reason: Model file reads and writes SettingsHandler.modularUi and saves through the handler.
layerViolations.fix: Toggle constants go to lib/models/settings/modular_ui_toggles.dart; isOn/set/revision go to lib/features/settings/logic/modular_ui.dart over a values map owned by the settings store.

layerViolations.reason: Enum (model) imports the handler for SettingsHandler.isDesktopPlatform and for `loc` through the handler's re-export.
layerViolations.fix: Add lib/core/platform/platform_info.dart (isDesktopPlatform); import gen/strings.g.dart directly.

bugs.title: LoliSync receive wipes the receiver's device-specific model threads, NPU choices and earlier download folders
bugs.scenario: Device A sends settings via LoliSync. Device B (which had custom model thread counts, Run on = NPU, and earlier download folders) ends up with all three cleared, and the next save persists that.
bugs.evidence: loli_sync_handler.dart:629-632 removes every deviceSpecificSettings key (incl. 'modelThreads','modelRunOn','earlierDownloadFolders') from the payload; storeSettings (loli_sync_handler.dart:80) calls loadFromJSON(content,false), which unconditionally runs modelThreads..clear()..addAll(ModelTasks.parseThreads(json['modelThreads'])) (null -> {}), the same for modelRunOn, and earlierDownloadFolders.clear() (settings_handler.dart:2290-2305).

bugs.title: Toolbar order Reset throws and leaves an empty button order that is then saved
bugs.scenario: Settings -> Viewer -> Toolbar buttons order -> reset icon: the list is cleared, then a TypeError is thrown; on leaving the page settingsHandler.buttonOrder = [] and the viewer toolbar shows no ordered buttons until restart (loadFromJSON re-adds the missing ones).
bugs.evidence: buttonOrder.clear(); buttonOrder.addAll(settingsHandler.map['buttonOrder']!['default']); the default is <String>[...GalleryButton.values.map((b) => b.toJson())] (settings_handler.dart:1062), but buttonOrder is List<GalleryButton>, so the dynamic argument fails the runtime cast. _onPopInvoked then writes settingsHandler.buttonOrder = [...buttonOrder]; hideable_appbar.dart:207 builds from settingsHandler.buttonOrder.

bugs.title: On a fresh install the Flow migration runs on the 2nd launch and overrides theme choices from the first session
bugs.scenario: New install, user picks the Pink theme and AMOLED in the first session. At the next launch the theme is reset to Flow/dark/no AMOLED/no dynamic colour.
bugs.evidence: loadSettings: no settings.json -> saveSettings writes flowSkinApplied=false (field default) and loadFromJSON is never called. The next start runs loadFromJSON(setMissingKeys:true) with flowSkinApplied false, so the theme, themeMode, isAmoled and useDynamicColor are overwritten and _flowMigrationPending saves it.

bugs.title: settings.json written non-atomically; concurrent unawaited saves can interleave
bugs.scenario: The app is killed during a save, or two saves overlap (e.g. ModularUi.set and an unawaited addTagToList/saveSettings from another page). settings.json is truncated or garbled; the next start's jsonDecode fails, json = {}, and every setting reverts to defaults.
bugs.evidence: saveSettings: settingsFile.openWrite(); writer.write(jsonEncode(toJson())); await writer.close() - no temp file or rename, no lock. Many callers do not await (addTagToList:2811, removeTagFromList:2828, addTagToBooruHiddenList:2848, recommendations toggles, VersionButton). loadFromJSON catches the decode error and continues with {}.

bugs.title: Loading a settings file without buttonOrder/disabledButtons throws out of loadFromJSON
bugs.scenario: An empty or corrupt settings.json (see the non-atomic write) gives jsonDecode failure -> json = {} -> the setMissingKeys loop reaches 'buttonOrder' and throws. The rest of the defaults and the Flow migration are skipped and the 'init error' snackbar shows.
bugs.evidence: map.forEach(... setByString(key, map[key]!['default'])) with no try/catch; setByString('buttonOrder') assigns validatedValue (a List<String> default, settings_handler.dart:1062) to List<GalleryButton> buttonOrder (line 1759), giving a TypeError; the same for disabledButtons <String>[]. initialize() catches and shows the snackbar.

bugs.title: Changing a booru's URL (and name) adds a new config instead of replacing the old one
bugs.scenario: Edit booru 'X' (URL A) -> change URL to B and name to 'Y' -> Save: 'X' stays (file and list entry) and 'Y' is added. With only the URL changed, the in-memory list holds two 'X' entries until restart.
bugs.evidence: The old-config removal loop only considers entries whose baseURL == booruURLController.text (the NEW URL); the old entry with URL A never matches, so deleteBooru(widget.booru) is not called. saveBooru then booruList.add(newBooru).

bugs.title: Per-booru hidden lines are keyed by name: lost on rename, stored under 'New' for an unsaved booru
bugs.scenario: (a) Rename a booru: its per-booru hidden lines no longer apply (they stay under the old name). (b) In 'Add new booru', add lines before saving: they are stored under the key 'New' and never apply to the saved booru.
bugs.evidence: _PerBooruBlacklistEditor(booruName: widget.booru.name) writes via addTagToBooruHiddenList(booruName!, line); new boorus are constructed as Booru('New', ...) (booru_page.dart:116); onSave never migrates hiddenTagsPerBooru to the new name.

bugs.title: 'Hidden tags' row counts per-booru tags but opens the global Filters page
bugs.scenario: Booru source settings -> Hidden tags ('3 tags hidden on X') opens Settings -> Filters, which edits only the global hidden list; the per-booru lines are on the booru editor.
bugs.evidence: subtitle uses SettingsHandler.instance.hiddenTagsForBooru(booru.name).length; onTap pushes const TagsFiltersPage(), which edits settingsHandler.hiddenTags/markedTags.

bugs.title: Empty 'Items per page' makes the pop handler throw: limit not saved, default-booru prompt skipped
bugs.scenario: Clear the Items per page field and press back: FormatException; prefBooru prompt, itemLimit and saveSettings are skipped (defTags is set in memory only).
bugs.evidence: _onPopInvoked: settingsHandler.defTags = ...; if (int.parse(limitController.text) > 100) - int.parse('') throws; the digits-only formatter allows an empty field; the validator does not block the pop.

bugs.title: Empty snatch cooldown or cache size field: none of the Save & cache changes are saved
bugs.scenario: Clear 'Snatch cooldown' (or 'Cache size limit'), change other options, press back: FormatException in the pop handler; jsonWrite, cache toggles, cacheDuration, snatchMode etc. are not applied or saved.
bugs.evidence: settingsHandler.snatchCooldown = int.parse(snatchCooldownController.text); ... settingsHandler.cacheSize = int.parse(cacheSizeController.text); with no try or tryParse; saveSettings is at the end.

bugs.title: Save & cache page fails to open when cacheDuration is not one of the listed options
bugs.scenario: A settings.json (restored, synced or hand-edited) with cacheDuration e.g. 7200 s: firstWhere throws StateError in initState and the page shows an error.
bugs.evidence: cacheDurationSelected = settingsHandler.map['cacheDuration']!['options']!.firstWhere((dur) => dur['value'].inSeconds == cacheDuration.inSeconds); has no orElse; validateValue('duration') accepts any int (settings_handler.dart:1291).

bugs.title: Cache stats leak ReceivePorts and only the last isolate is killed
bugs.scenario: Each open of Save & cache (and each clear) spawns 6 isolates with 6 ReceivePorts that are never closed; dispose kills only the last isolate.
bugs.evidence: for each type: receivePort = ReceivePort(); isolate = await Isolate.spawn(...); receivePort.listen(...) - no receivePort.close(); dispose(): isolate?.kill() on the single field.

bugs.title: 'Tap to reset' on Endless recommendations sets 30 instead of clearing the override
bugs.scenario: In a doujin source's settings, override Endless, then tap 'Overridden for this source · tap to reset': the value becomes recommendedCount=30 (still overridden) and the marker never disappears.
bugs.evidence: _switchRow(... onChanged: (v) => _update((s) => s.recommendedCount = (v ?? false) ? 0 : 30)); the marker calls onChanged(null), giving 30, not null.

bugs.title: Global doujin layer shows no selected chip for unset choices
bugs.scenario: Settings -> Doujin -> Global: Reading direction, Page turn, Detail layout etc. show no chip selected although the effective default (ltr, animated, compact) applies.
bugs.evidence: final T? shown = layerValue ?? (isGlobal ? layerValue : inheritedValue); on the global layer this is null when unset, so no ChoiceChip is selected.

bugs.title: Slideshow duration silently clamped to 10 s on exit
bugs.scenario: Enter 30000 ms in 'Slideshow duration': after leaving the page it is 10000 ms, although the schema allows up to 100000 and the UI has no max.
bugs.evidence: settingsHandler.galleryAutoScrollTime = (int.tryParse(...) ?? 4000).clamp(100, 10000); map 'galleryAutoScrollTime' upperLimit 100000 (settings_handler.dart:673); numberMax double.infinity.

bugs.title: Login cookie check can run twice and pop two routes
bugs.scenario: The 1.5 s poll and onLoadStop both call _checkCookies while readJar is pending; both pass the _done guard before the await, both store the session and both call Navigator.pop. The second pop closes the page underneath (Accounts / booru editor). The same pattern exists in ehentai_login_page.dart:55 (_finishing is set only after the await).
bugs.evidence: if (_done) return; final parsed = ...(await session.readJar()); ... _done = true; ... Navigator.of(context).pop(...) with no re-check after the await; mounted stays true during the pop animation.

bugs.title: A corrupt sourceSettings.json is silently dropped and then overwritten by the next change
bugs.scenario: sourceSettings.json is truncated (writeAsStringSync is not atomic) or holds a value of the wrong type: the load fails and is logged with _loaded=true; the next update() writes only the new entry and every source's settings are lost.
bugs.evidence: _ensureLoaded: jsonDecode / entry.value as Map / field casts inside one try; on an exception _byHost is partial or empty; _save writes _byHost wholesale.

bugs.title: disabledButtons with a non-disableable entry hits a concurrent-modification error and keeps the stale list
bugs.scenario: A settings file whose disabledButtons contains 'info' (an old version, sync or hand edit): removing it while iterating throws ConcurrentModificationError, which is caught; disabledButtons is not updated (on a restore it keeps the previous list).
bugs.evidence: for (final button in tempDisabledButtons) { ... tempDisabledButtons.remove(button); } inside the try at 2225-2258.

bugs.title: 'What's new' title shows the remote version instead of the installed one
bugs.scenario: After updating, the What's-new page title reads 'What's new: <latest GitHub version>' while the body is Constants.updateInfo (installed).
bugs.evidence: _updateInfo = isAfterUpdate ? Constants.updateInfo : updateInfo.value; but the title uses updateInfo.value!.versionName/buildNumber.

bugs.title: Fork checks upstream NO-ob update.json
bugs.scenario: When upstream's build_number exceeds this fork's 5211, users get 'Update available' pointing to upstream releases (which would replace the fork).
bugs.evidence: DioNetwork.get('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NO-ob/LoliSnatcher_Droid/master/$updateFileName'); compares Constants.updateInfo.buildNumber < json build_number.

bugs.title: 'double' settings are never validated (no case)
bugs.scenario: mousewheelScrollSpeed/preloadSizeLimit from JSON are taken raw: no range check, and an int value (e.g. from an older sync) causes a TypeError on assignment, swallowed per key.
bugs.evidence: validateValue switch has no 'double' case, so default: return value; setByString assigns validatedValue to a double field.

bugs.title: deleteBooru throws when the booru file is missing
bugs.scenario: Delete a booru whose file was already removed or renamed: File.delete throws FileSystemException, uncaught in the booru_page delete dialog; the dialog stays open with selectedBooru already changed.
bugs.evidence: await booruFile.delete(); with no exists check or try; booru_page.dart:309 awaits it without try.

bugs.title: setState after dispose in the POEditor card and the language dropdown
bugs.scenario: Open Language and leave before the POEditor request (network) or loadAllLocales completes: setState on a disposed State (debug assert; release null-check error in the zone). The same in privacy_page.dart:34 (canCheckBiometrics().then(setState)) and theme_page.dart:123 (debounced callback after an awaited save).
bugs.evidence: _fetchLanguages: await DioNetwork.post(...); setState(...) with no mounted check; initState: LocaleSettings.instance.loadAllLocales().then((_) { setState(() {}); }).

bugs.title: setState given an async callback
bugs.scenario: Purge failed items: setState(purgeFailedSankakuItems) passes a Future-returning function, so in debug Flutter throws 'setState() callback argument returned a Future'.
bugs.evidence: action: () { setState(purgeFailedSankakuItems); }

bugs.title: Empty mouse wheel field throws in the pop handler (desktop)
bugs.scenario: Desktop only: clear 'Mouse wheel scroll modifier' and leave: FormatException, and the Interface page's changes are not saved.
bugs.evidence: settingsHandler.mousewheelScrollSpeed = double.parse(mouseSpeedController.text); before saveSettings.

fragile.rule: Key names and value encodings must stay readable both ways: legacy enum strings ('Full Res', 'Stream+Cache', 'Ask', 'Post URL with tags', 'Disabled', 'auto-safe', 'gpu-next', 'mediacodec_embed', 'loli_snatcher'...), legacy hatedTags/lovedTags read as hiddenTags/markedTags, buttonOrder as a list or a comma string, cacheDuration in seconds, colours as ARGB ints, theme by name, locale by name.

fragile.what: Non-declared maps written next to the declared settings
fragile.where: settings_handler.dart toJson/loadFromJSON (modularUi, modelTasks, modelThreads, modelRunOn, earlierDownloadFolders, hiddenTagsPerBooru)
fragile.rule: Store only values that differ from the default (ModularUi.set removes defaults, ModelTasks the same); ModularUi.parse keeps only String->bool. They ride in settings backups.

fragile.where: lib/src/data/modular_ui.dart and the 10 consumer widgets (main_search_query_editor_page, main_drawer, drawer_quick_access, waterfall_view, thumbnail, linked_media_sheet, video_surface_cap, image_viewer, tag_view, status_bar_inset)
fragile.rule: Values load before the first screen; a widget checks ModularUi.isOn in an `if` where it builds and never builds then hides. New UI removals become toggles (user rule). Defaults: search History/Pinned/Popular and app.drawUnderHiddenStatusBar off, the rest on (modular_ui_test asserts). Keys 'modular-ui-<key>'.
Runs only on startup loads (setMissingKeys) while flowSkinApplied is false, and is saved immediately (_flowMigrationPending); never on LoliSync payloads.
appMode is overwritten after every load. isDebug survives restarts (r80); 6 taps on Version enable it, long-press disables it.
These keys are not sent over LoliSync. The list includes modelThreads/modelRunOn/capturesPath/earlierDownloadFolders (r80-r82).
Calls SearchHandler.filterCurrentFetched() and rootRestate after 1 s; the Settings hub and Debug exits, Interface (predictive back change) and first launch rely on it.

fragile.where: SettingsHandler.parseTagsListForItem, SourceSettingsHandler.isItemHiddenForDoujin/tagBlacklistForItem, booru_edit_page (per-booru blacklist hidden for doujin boorus)
fragile.rule: Doujin items never use booru blacklists or marked tags and vice versa (standing user rule; doujin_separation_test guards it).

Effective = source override ?? global ?? default; global under '_global'; layers keyed by baseURL host (keyFor); only non-null fields are serialized and empty layers dropped; contentTypes/siteVariant/blacklistMode are source-only; reloadFromDisk after restore; resetForTests for tests.

Query first, then the default of each filter group the query leaves unset (only values the site offers, lowercase match), then always-add words not already present; doujin sources are untouched (booru_source_settings_test).
Every change to hiddenTags or hiddenTagsPerBooru must invalidate it (tags_filters_page calls it manually after replacing the set; loadFromJSON calls it).

fragile.what: Booru list order and virtual boorus
fragile.rule: Virtual boorus are added only when dbEnabled and real boorus exist; order is alphabetical, preferred booru first, then Favourites, Downloads, For You, For You (doujin), Boards, Collections, History last; non-saveable booru files are deleted on load.
Booru files are named by the sanitized name; after saving, SearchHandler.applyBooruEdit re-points open tabs, the first tab is created when none exist, and a root restate follows.

fragile.what: Settings hub source layout read by a test
fragile.rule: The test reads the file by its path and the literal `_sectionLabel(context, 'SECTION')` and `const XPage()` strings in order. Moving or renaming the file, or changing that syntax, breaks the test.
Keep or forward these statics when moving logic; tests replace them.

Values are copied into page state and committed on exit (changes made while on the page are lost if the app is killed). Theme commits after a 500 ms debounce; Recommendations, Modular UI, Links, Models and Debug captures commit immediately.
Without the registry, enum keys in loadFromJSON fall through validateValue and fail to assign; tests that load JSON must init it.

fragile.where: settings.json proxyPassword/customUserAgent; boorus/*.json apiKey/userID (RedGifs token); FA/e-hentai/eahentai session files; Drive OAuth client in secure storage
fragile.rule: LogRedaction scrubs logs; booru share asks before including credentials; sessions are kept out of the image servers' cookies (scrubJar / seedJar for one visit).

perf.issue: `map` is a getter that rebuilds the whole ~150-entry schema (including 9 ThemeItems and a duration option list) on every access; validateValue, toJson and loadFromJSON call it once per key, and settings pages call settingsHandler.map[...] repeatedly in build/validators.
perf.impact: About 150 x 150 map-entry allocations per saveSettings and per startup load (on the critical startup path before runApp); repeated on every settings page rebuild.
perf.safeFix: static final schema built once (desktop-dependent defaults are per-process constants); keep the `map` getter returning it.

perf.issue: saveSettings calls getStoragePermission() on every save (platform-channel getAndroidSDKVersion, and a permission request on Android < 33) although settings.json lives in the app's own config dir.
perf.impact: An extra method-channel round trip per save; saves happen on every settings page exit, every toggle on several pages and every tag add.
perf.safeFix: Request storage permission once at startup (it is already called in initialize).

perf.issue: blacklistedTagTokens builds a new Set from all global lines on every call; parseTagsList (per thumbnail and tag list) and containsHidden call it.
perf.impact: O(lines x tokens) allocation per rendered item while scrolling the grid.
perf.safeFix: Cache the token set beside _cachedGlobalLines and clear both in invalidateBlacklistCache.

perf.issue: _save() rewrites sourceSettings.json synchronously on the UI thread for every update. The 'Always add' field (booru_source_settings_view.dart:111) and the doujin 'Tag blacklist' field (source_settings_page.dart:717) call update on every keystroke.
perf.impact: Synchronous disk write per keystroke and per chip tap; jank on slow storage.
perf.safeFix: Debounce plus an async write of a temp file followed by a rename.

perf.issue: Lazy first load uses readAsStringSync and jsonDecode on whichever thread first asks; often a thumbnail/card build (gridTagStrip, coverDisplay) or a search.
perf.impact: A synchronous file read inside the first feed frame.
perf.safeFix: Preload asynchronously during postInit; keep the lazy fallback.

perf.issue: tagBlacklistForItem resolves the doujin booru per item, Uri.tryParse in keyFor, and splits/joins/lowercases the blacklist strings on every call (parseTagsListForItem per doujin card, isItemHiddenForDoujin per filtered item).
perf.impact: Repeated string processing per item in doujin feeds.
perf.safeFix: Cache the resolved Set per host; invalidate in update/updateGlobal/reloadFromDisk.

perf.issue: _credentialCapabilities builds a new BooruHandler through the factory on each access (5 accesses per build) and build runs on every keystroke (onChanged: setState).
perf.impact: Handler construction several times per keystroke in the editor.
perf.safeFix: Compute once when the type or URL changes and store it in state.

perf.issue: Leaving Settings always calls saveSettings(restate:true): refilter every tab plus a full-app rootRestate after 1 s, even when nothing changed.
perf.impact: A whole-app rebuild on every Settings exit.
perf.safeFix: Snapshot toJson on entry and restate only when filter- or theme-relevant keys changed (keep today's behaviour when unsure).

perf.issue: Cache stats spawn one isolate per cache type (6) on open and again after each clear; the ports are never closed.
perf.impact: Six isolate spawns per visit plus leaked ports.
perf.safeFix: One isolate computes every type in a single pass; close the ports.

perf.issue: _doujinSources constructs a BooruHandler for every configured booru in each build; source_settings_page does the same for _doujinHandlers and _accountBlacklistHandler (the latter per access).
perf.impact: Handler construction for N boorus per build of these pages.
perf.safeFix: Use BooruType/DoujinDataHandler.isDoujinSource checks or cache the handlers in initState.

perf.issue: The contents list renders every capture entry eagerly inside a ListView children array.
perf.impact: Slow rebuilds for large captures (each revision tick rebuilds them all).
perf.safeFix: ListView.builder / a SliverList for the entries.
